description.value: Breka Bakery & Café is a Vancouver-born family business operating since 2006 with 8 locations across the city, each open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Originally rooted in a German bakery tradition in the Sunset neighbourhood, it has grown into a beloved local institution offering artisan breads, pastries, cakes, sandwiches, and hot beverages. The Main Street location is a reliable stop for touring cyclists at any hour, with a broad menu that includes explicitly labeled vegan and gluten-free items.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Breka Bakery & Café is an active, 24/7 café-bakery with 8 Vancouver locations, matching the OSM record's name and Main Street address. The website's dedicated vegan and gluten-free menu sections, plus a 'Grab & Go' category and online ordering app, support those amenity values. No evidence in website content or OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging, so those remain null.
concerns: Website contact page uses only a form with no phone number displayed, so the OSM phone number (+16045590900) could not be confirmed from website content.
Website lists 8 locations but provides no per-location addresses; the OSM record's Main Street address cannot be independently verified from website content alone.
Washrooms, bike parking, and water refill are unverifiable from available evidence — an in-person visit or direct contact would be needed to confirm these for WWC accreditation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, well-established food and drink business open 24/7 with a broad menu including vegan and GF options and takeout — a genuinely useful stop for touring cyclists at any hour.
